Lets owners of BMW EVs down. This application documents the sluggish transition of BMW from internal combustion engines to EVs. 

For an ICE vehicle being able to set up your destination and check on whether the windows are closed are nice features to have. For an EV, being able to check up on the current charge status, charge progress and build a route plan on long-distance journeys, including planned break/charging points are necessary. And this application is not yet up to that task. An obvious sign of this is the fact that the map view has a "petrol station" button, even if your vehicle is fully electric. Then there is the emphasis on servicing, despite the fact that EV servicing is limited to checking the tyres and topping up screen wash. Can I also ask for an advance warning "your car will be charged in 10 minutes" messages. I am using A Better Route Planner for route planning, and trip review and 
that really shows what is possible. Finally, I really wish BMW would supply the integration needed for Apple maps to be the EV aware -as they have demonstrated at Apple events. Please BMW: improve your phone integration.
